_comment: Shared defaults for every tenant loader. Individual tenants override these in tenants/<tenantId>.json. Change a value here and it reaches every tenant on the next publish — no tenant deploy.
_apiComment: Tenants reach the tracking API through our own CDN, which forwards to the backend directly. The marketing app is deliberately not in the data path — a deploy there must not be able to stop ingest across every tenant.
_fingerprintComment: Served from our CDN rather than jsdelivr: this executes on every tenant's site, so a third party in that position is both an availability risk (blocked networks) and a supply-chain one. Pinned to an exact version, sha256 recorded in tenants/VENDOR.md.
_domMutationComment: virtualNumbers and whatsapp both rewrite content on a client's live page, and are on by default. A tenant whose hostname is unregistered or whose number pool is empty will call assign and get a 4xx/5xx on every page view; the tracker reports that as virtual_number_assign_failed rather than failing silently, and nothing on the page is altered. Set enabled:false per tenant to opt out.
